需《业余无线电台操作证书》+ 电台执照: Requires an amateur radio operator certificate + station licence
低功率（约 0.5 W e.r.p.，以附件 3 为准）: Low power (about 0.5 W e.r.p.; see Annex 3)
按执照类别，可较大功率: By licence class; can be higher
不得要求免受有害干扰: May not claim protection from harmful interference
按业余业务规则，次要业务需避让主要业务: Amateur rules; secondary service must avoid the primary service
不得具备使用业余电台频段的能力: Must not be capable of using amateur bands
不得按公众对讲机免执照使用: Must not be used licence-free as a PMR radio
中国业余卫星系列（CAS-3），共 6 颗，均搭载 U/V 模式 20 kHz: Chinese amateur satellite series (CAS-3), 6 satellites, each with a U/V 20 kHz linear transponder; several have re-entered — check the AMSAT status page for current availability.
把上行通带里的整段信号搬到下行通带，SSB/CW 可同时通联；XW-2 为反相（: Moves the whole uplink passband onto the downlink so SSB/CW can operate simultaneously; XW-2 is inverting (uplink up, downlink down).
工作于 409 MHz 频段、免执照的低功率对讲机，只用于短距离日常通信，不能进: A licence-free low-power radio on 409 MHz for short-range everyday use; it cannot use amateur bands.
工作在业余频段的收发信机，操作者须持操作证书、设备须办执照，功率与用途都受业余电: A transceiver on amateur bands; the operator needs a certificate and the equipment needs a licence; power and use follow amateur rules.
XW-2 转发器频率是发射时的设计值；卫星会随寿命关停，操作前务必查 AMSAT: XW-2 frequencies are the launch design values; satellites shut down over their lifetime, so check the AMSAT status page before operating.
公众对讲机「免执照」只适用于 409 MHz 低功率那一类：拿业余手台当公众对讲: The licence-free status applies only to the low-power 409 MHz PMR class: using an amateur handheld as a PMR radio, or modifying a PMR radio onto amateur bands, both break their own rules.
公众对讲机与业余手台的频段、功率、执照要求完全不同，两者不能互相替代。: PMR radios and amateur handhelds differ completely in band, power and licence requirements; they are not interchangeable.
409 MHz 公众对讲机不享有干扰保护，遇到干扰自行换信道即可。: 409 MHz PMR radios have no interference protection; just switch channels if you hit interference.
